name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
read: Revenue guidance missed despite four reaffirmations; order inflow delivered. Margins and FY27 targets lack disclosed outcomes, so trust guidance directionally, not precisely.

events.label: FY26 revenue growth guidance 15%
events.quote: Guidance held at 15% all year; delivered 11.8%. Missed, blamed on Q4 supply-chain slippage of ~Rs 50 billion.

events.label: Energy margin softness baked in 8.5% guidance
events.quote: 8.5% P&M margin guidance maintained through Q3 FY26; no FY26 actual P&M margin provided in facts.

events.label: P&M EBITDA margin 8.5% FY26
events.quote: Management claimed 7.9% nine-month margin on track for 8.5%, but FY26 actual P&M margin absent from facts.

events.label: FY26 order inflow to exceed 10% growth
events.to: FY26 order inflows: Q1 +33%, Q2 +45%, Q3 +17% (record Rs 1,356bn), Q4 broadly flat; order book +28% YoY
events.quote: Guidance was to exceed 10% order inflow growth; nine-month momentum and 28% order-book growth indicate delivered.

events.label: Energy margin softness baked in 8.5% guidance
events.quote: The current southward movement in Energy margins is baked, I reiterate, is baked when we have given the guidance of 8.5%.

events.label: FY26 order inflow to exceed 10% growth
events.quote: We are confident of exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows
